items.title: Months After Patch, WinRAR Bug Poised to Hit SMBs Hardest
items.description: Russian and Chinese nation-state attackers are exploiting a months-old WinRAR vulnerability, despite a patch that came out last July.

items.title: Consumers Reluctant to Shop at Stores That Don't Take Security Seriously
items.description: The retail sector must adapt as consumers become more cybersecurity-conscious. Increased attack transparency is a good place to start.
